name: Coral Lecithin
headline: Coral Lecithin
description: A source of phosphatidylcholine, a key building block of every cell membrane in the body. It is also a precursor of choline, which supports metabolism in nerve tissue and brain cells, and the body needs it throughout life.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule 2-3 times a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
